title: Location-specific P-spline normal references for sensor anomaly detection: code, primary outputs and registrations
description: Code, configurations, primary outputs and pre-registration documents (with their chronology) for the manuscript Location-Specific P-Spline Normal References for Sensor Anomaly Detection with Incomplete Training Data (A. Lim and J. H. Cho, submitted to Mathematics, manuscript mathematics-4658477, first revision). Covers every analysis on public data (UWB datasets D2, D5, D6, HYMN; Wi-Fi fingerprints; SMD/ASD) and the simulation study. The in-house dataset D1 and positioning experiments are not included. See README.md and REGISTRATIONS.md.
